changelog: New Visual Effects & GIFs: Express yourself with brand new effects .
Smart Effect Suggestions: Easily find and trigger your favorite effects as you type in chat.
Cleaner Chat Experience: Smoother WatchParty room joining and smarter floating notifications.

features.title: What's New
items: New Effects & Animated GIFs: Celebrate with new visual effects (Zoro and Spider) and send animated GIF reactions directly in chat.
Multiple Reaction Stack: Send multiple likes and stack effects simultaneously for even bigger celebrations.
Smart Effect Suggestions: Typing `/effect` now shows an instant preview list of available effects as you type.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Refined Chat Design: Visual upgrades to chat messages and suggestion menus for better readability.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Smarter Floating Notifications: On-screen preview badges now accurately filter out system messages and your own sent messages to reduce clutter.
